title: Screening and Detection of SARS-CoV-2 RNA from Buffy Coats
author: Mahesh Bachu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgarjsd6

steps.title: Collect Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the buffy bag from a sealed NYBC container to a BSL2 hood and spray the surface with 70% Ethanol. Use a 21 or 22 gauge needle with a 5-10 ml syringe to collect ~100 - 200 µl of blood by puncturing the top of the buffy bag tubing.

steps.title: Perform Initial Erythrocyte Lysis
steps.instruction: Aspirate 5 volumes of Lysis Buffer (L5) for every 1 volume of fresh whole blood (e.g., 500 μl L5 for 100 μl blood) using the same syringe. Cap the syringe using the one-handed scoop method and incubate in the hood for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate and Complete Lysis
steps.instruction: Transfer the syringe contents into a 1.5 ml sterile RNase-free microfuge tube and incubate on ice for 10 minutes. Briefly vortex the tube 2-3 times during incubation until the solution becomes translucent.

steps.title: Isolate Leukocyte Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 4°C at 400 x g for 10 minutes. Completely remove and discard the supernatant, retaining the pellet.

steps.title: Wash Leukocyte Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Lysis Buffer (L5) (e.g., 200 μl L5 per 100 μl original blood) and mix by brief vortexing. Centrifuge at 4°C at 400 x g for 5 minutes, then discard the supernatant. If the pellet is significantly red, wash again with Lysis Buffer (L5) until the pellet is white.

steps.title: Prepare Leukocyte Lysate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the white leukocyte pellet in 350 μl Lysis Buffer (L3) and vortex briefly to ensure no cell clumps remain.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Spin Cartridge
steps.instruction: Add 350 μl 70% ethanol to the tube and vortex briefly. Transfer the lysate to a Spin Cartridge in a Collection Tube and centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature. Discard the flow-through and place the cartridge back into the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash RNA
steps.instruction: Add 700 μl of Wash Buffer (W4) to the Spin Cartridge and centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature.

steps.title: Optional DNase I Digestion
steps.instruction: To remove genomic DNA, add 80 μl of DNase I solution to the Spin Cartridge and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Post-Digestion Wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 μl of Wash Buffer (W4) to the Spin Cartridge. If DNase I was used, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature. Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Final Wash and Drying
steps.instruction: Add 500 μl of Wash Buffer (W5) with ethanol and centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 30 seconds. Repeat this wash once. Discard flow-through, transfer the cartridge to the kit's Wash Tube, and centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 1 minute to remove residual W5.

steps.title: Elute Purified RNA
steps.instruction: Place the Spin Cartridge in a clean 1.7-ml Elution Tube. Add 20-50 μl of sterile, RNase-free water to the center of the cartridge. Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 1 minute. Store the resulting total RNA at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare rRT-PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Place rRT-PCR buffer, enzyme, and primer/probes on ice/cold-block. Mix by inversion 5 times and centrifuge for 5 seconds. Calculate the number of reactions (N): if samples (n) including controls are 1-14, N = n + 1; if 15 or more, N = n + 2. Prepare the mix for each primer/probe set in 1.5 mL tubes.

steps.title: Set Up Reaction Plate
steps.instruction: Set up reaction strip tubes or plates in a 96-well cooler rack. Dispense 15 μL of each master mix into the appropriate wells across the row.

steps.title: Prepare Controls and Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the plate in the nucleic acid handling area. Vortex extracted RNA samples for 5 seconds and centrifuge for 5 seconds before placing in a cold rack.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 5 μL of nuclease-free water into NTC sample wells (column 1) and cap.
Pipette 5.0 μL of each sample into wells (columns 2-11), changing tips between samples and capping immediately.
If required, add 5 μL of Human Specimen Control (HSC) to column 11 and cap.
Pipette 5 μL of nCoVPC RNA into column 12 and cap.

steps.title: Finalize and Run PCR
steps.instruction: Centrifuge reaction tube strips for 10-15 seconds (or 96-well plates for 30 seconds at 500 x g, 4°C). Create a Run Template based on the instrument and run the real-time PCR machine according to CDC documentation.
